[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
bytes = "1"
http-body-util = "0.1"
hyper = { version = "1", features = ["http1", "server"] }
hyper-util = { version = "0.1", features = ["tokio"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "net", "macros", "sync"] }

[profile.release]
codegen-units = 1
lto = true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary and places it at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/kvhttp ./app
